links.outcome: Site-level variation in sepsis model discrimination (AUROC) across 4 health systems
links.effect: Encounter-level AUROC ranged from 0.82 (95% CI, 0.81-0.83) to 0.92 (95% CI, 0.92-0.93) across sites; prediction-level 12-hour AUROC ranged from 0.75 to 0.85; authors note high institutional variability.
links.quote: At the encounter level, the AUROC ranged from 0.82 (95% CI, 0.81-0.83) to 0.92 (95% CI, 0.92-0.93) across study sites.

links.outcome: Positive predictive value and alert burden of sepsis model alerts
links.effect: PPV was low, 0.13 (95% CI, 0.13-0.14) to 0.26 (95% CI, 0.25-0.27), with a high number needed to evaluate and high alert burden.
links.quote: Positive predictive values remained low, from 0.13 (95% CI, 0.13-0.14) to 0.26 (95% CI, 0.25-0.27), with a high number needed to evaluate and high alert burden.

screen.reason: Evaluated the prospective performance, institutional variability, and alert burden of an implemented proprietary sepsis prediction model (Epic Sepsis Model v2) across 4 major health systems immediately following go-live.

primary.practice: multicenter post-implementation validation across clinical sites
